set.body: Goal: explicit closing gate for the roadmap. Verify and record: conformance contract green on at least two real backends; visual gallery signed off with polish issues resolved or explicitly waived; theme + typed stats landed; DSL consumed by at least one domain module (DesignGraphics reimplemented on it); full testAll green JVM+JS. Deliverable: a short assessment note on this issue grading the system against the original 10/10 criteria, plus follow-on issues for anything that keeps it below 10. No implementation beyond the assessment.
set.title: Graphics: 10/10 re-grade gate
